sections.name: Upgrade + ownership surface (UUPS, proxy admins, the 7702 delegate)
sections.evidence: Fork S6 (recon/fork_s6_owner_account.py): a STRANGER calling execute(bytes32,bytes) on the owner account reverts NotEntryPointOrSelf() (0x0796d945) across 4 mode/encoding variants, and the real transactions return status 0x0 -> no third-party path to the owner's powers. The 7702 delegate 0x63c0c19a... is a standard ERC-4337 v0.7 smart account (entryPoint() = 0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032, validateUserOp 0x19822f7c, ERC-1271 isValidSignature, ERC-165, eip712Domain); acting as it requires the owner's signature over a UserOp. upgradeTo from a stranger -> NotOwner(address,address) on RPS and a revert on BankRoll; RPS's EIP-1967 admin slot is zero (UUPS-style). The three 149-byte proxies resolve to substantive impls (root 15,531B / registry 8,717B / resolver 12,846B, exposing owner()+registry()) under the OTHER owner 0xb34f876c...: a registry/resolver system with no value path found to the casino money flow.

sections.name: Undeployed/testnet-only games + the bundle's game registry
sections.evidence: RESOLVED, and it RETRACTS the earlier coverage gap. The frontend bundle carries the per-chain game registry: on mainnet, HiLo/War/DragonTiger/Keno/WheelOfFortune/SicBo/Crash are configured as "0x" (not deployed), and their testnet addresses have 0 bytes of code on mainnet (eth_getCode verified). So 13 registry entries resolve to 12 distinct mainnet addresses = 11 game proxies + the bankroll, ALL already mapped. HiLo's player-supplied currentCard is NOT on mainnet and therefore presents no outsider risk. NEW FINDING: Dice is mapped to the RANGE contract 0x0B1E533e (Dice_Play/Dice_GetState/Dice_Refund are absent there - empty reverts - while Range_GetState is present), so the app routes Dice players to a contract that cannot play Dice. See F07.
